description: Bachalpsee is the small alpine lake above Grindelwald, in a bowl of tawny late-September turf, with the Schreckhorn and the Wetterhorn beyond the far shore. This is not the Eiger north face, which is seen from the valley. The lake is unfrozen under a cold overcast sky, and the high faces are in cloud. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast, near 9 degrees at this cell, with no rain and no fresh snow on the shore.
